whoAmI.description: I'm Victor Rodrigues, a Full-Stack Developer focused on building modern, secure and scalable web applications. I apply software development best practices, software architecture and user experience in every project I work on, turning technical knowledge into real-world solutions.

studies.title: What I study
studies.description: I'm currently deepening my knowledge in Full-Stack development, software architecture, application security and databases. I combine technical training, continuous learning and hands-on project development to keep growing as a professional.

mainTech.title: Main technologies
mainTech.description: I primarily work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, C#, Java, React and PostgreSQL, building modern applications focused on performance, security and scalability. I complement these skills with knowledge of APIs, authentication, databases and cloud infrastructure.

goals.title: Professional goals
goals.description: Continue evolving as a Full-Stack Developer through practical experience, real projects and ongoing training. Among my future goals are enrolling in a Computer Engineering degree and deepening my knowledge in Cybersecurity and Artificial Intelligence, contributing to the development of innovative and secure technology solutions.

desbravadoresProject.subtitle: Travel Blog · Client Project
desbravadoresProject.overview: Desbravadores na Estrada is a website built for a travel blog, designed for intuitive navigation and to highlight content about destinations, experiences and itineraries. The project was built with WordPress and Elementor, prioritizing performance, easy content management and a consistent experience across devices.
desbravadoresProject.problem: Create a modern, easy-to-maintain website that could publish content organized by categories, with a strong focus on user experience and mobile optimization.
desbravadoresProject.solution: A WordPress solution with Elementor Pro was developed using a mobile-first approach, custom templates, a clear category structure and a clean design that makes reading and discovering new content easier.

dservicesProject.name: D.Services Limpezas, Lda
dservicesProject.subtitle: Corporate Website · Client Project
dservicesProject.overview: D.Services Limpezas is a professional cleaning company in Figueira da Foz. The corporate website was built with Next.js to present services, build trust and make it easy to request a quote, with a clear, modern experience on any device.
dservicesProject.problem: The company needed a professional digital presence to communicate office, residential and post-construction cleaning services, with a simple path to requesting a quote.
dservicesProject.solution: A Next.js corporate website was developed with a distinct visual identity, service pages, FAQ, legal information and a direct contact flow for quotes, optimized for performance, SEO and mobile use.
